verdict.rationale: Kino exposes an MCP server so external agents like Claude Code and Cursor can search footage and edit projects, which makes shipping agent skills a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions installable skills, automatic skill triggering from task context, or descriptions written to steer when an agent activates a skill. The MCP server and the video templates are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, installed skills trigger automatically from task context, with descriptions engineered so the agent activates the right skill at the right moment
